title: Saves 1½” of Storage Space, But Is Hard to Open
text:
Saves 1½” of Storage Space, But Is Hard to Open. This RAPID BRANDS MICROWAVE SPLATTER COVER (Vented; Dishwasher Safe; BPA-Free) measures 1¼” when collapsed, and 2¾” when fully opened. Thus it can save 1½” of storage space, but it is difficult to open and close. Unfolding it takes two hands, and a fair amount of force.

The splatter cover unfolds to the same height as[[ASIN:B00LQCB6I6 this non-collapsible splatter cover]] that I’ve been using. I much prefer the non-collapsible cover, which works exactly the same as the collapsible one.

The non-collapsible cover is easier to use, and easier to clean than this one. The non-collapsible cover is made of a single piece of flexible plastic, so that it lacks the food-collecting crevices of this cover.
